The '''''Shepherd''-class shuttle''' was a type of [[Ithorian Herdship]] design developed by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

Fabricated with a disk-shaped [[Hull/Legends|hull]], the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] contained a small [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] and living area. Dominating the interior of the ship was a miniature [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] ecology with both flora and fauna, which included examples from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].<ref name="OpEl" />
